Mock Data Generator

Define fields (name, email, phone, uuid, lorem, number, date…) and generate realistic JSON or CSV rows.

📖 How to use

  1. Add field rows and pick a type for each.
  2. Set how many rows to generate.
  3. Generate — view as JSON or CSV, copy or download.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which field types are available?

name, email, phone, company, city, lorem, number, date, boolean, and uuid.

How many rows can I generate?

Yes — generate 1 to 1000 rows per click.

Which output formats are supported?

JSON array or CSV with headers — download either as a file.

Is the data real?

No — the data is randomly generated placeholder text, fine for dev and demos.
